[*]I don’t have the expansions installed; compatibility have been done based on, “theory” and [i]hasn’t been play tested[/i] (would be [b]great [u]if users could confirm/deny[/u] that it works[/b])
[*]
[*][spoiler]the [url=https://www.gardenia.net/plant/lycoris-sprengeri]"actual" blue spider lily / Lycoris sprengeri[/url] does not look like this, and this is more of a [url=https://kimetsu-no-yaiba.fandom.com/wiki/Blue_Spider_Lily]mythical recolour version of Lycoris radiata[/url] (red spider lily); you know, like blue roses. White spider lily = [url=https://www.gardenia.net/plant/lycoris-albiflora]Lycoris albiflora[/url]. Gold spider lily = [url=https://www.gardenia.net/plant/lycoris-aurea]Lycoris aurea[/url].[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]the [url=https://www.deviantart.com/jorapache/art/Purple-snail-39149487]viral deviantart purple snail[/url] - [spoiler]photographer has declared colour has [b]not[/b] been manipulated in any way, but many are convinced it’s been photoshopped; my theory is that it may have been near something like a silkworm farm where they change the colour via diet before harvesting and this particular snail was an accident. A biologist would know better whether or not this is possible since nobody does this to snails on purpose. The alternative answer(deceit), is boring.
[i]Decided to do the violet sea snail ([url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Janthina_janthina]Janthina janthina[/url]) afterwards; must be 1 of the most elusive snails ever, almost as though the flesh has never been photographed before, all the photos show bubble rafts by the snail.[/i] Just found [url=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Violet_snail_Janthina_sp.png]this photo[/url]; guess i got the colour of the flesh wrong :')[/spoiler][/spoiler][*][spoiler]Chrysozephyrus - a number of species under the genus look really similar so I’m just leaving half the species name[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Mud house/structures are supposedly [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mudbrick]mud brick[/url]/[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rammed_earth]rammed earth[/url] buildings. The pool is…… just a concept. lol [spoiler]i mean…. Even if it’s lined with waterproofing membrane or coated with several layers of clay… the load and plumbing would be an issue. Just treat the whole thing as a concept-only thing :’D[/spoiler][/spoiler]
[*]
[*]Happy with most of the options except for a few, falling somewhat short when it comes to visually integrating with everything else - probably fix them in subsequent updates.
